about: Lit as in lighting.json, working from 155 s, and the flue is 77 degrees and falls a degree a minute, as it fell on 26.09 17:32 when the pellets ran out: ten degrees under the highest of ten minutes is no fuel, and the fire is burnt off before the twelfth minute of work under a weak flame (6.17); the flue is asked of a flame that is not steady (6.6, 6.17).
